title: Research: one-sided E8 mask rigidity on 1,373 punctured units (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Research note / scoped negative result; no new kappa or supplier.** A decoder that is correct only on the even-inner-product mask already has the full all-pairs product if **one** factor lies in the live E8 root-coordinate column space. The other factor is unrestricted, and the term count is arbitrary. Diagonals and ordinary complex transpose are essential.

This covers P112, all 112 one-line P111 punctures, and all 1260 frame-pair P104 punctures. An elementary covariance/Bessel argument also covers deletions contained in at most eight orthogonal sets; that larger family is proved parametrically, not enumerated. Consequently mask relaxation alone offers no copied-information saving in this class. Unrestricted masked factors, better all-pairs decoders and physical supplier costs remain open.

Only `research/complex-masked-rigidity-seed28/` is added. Start with its `README.md` and `PROOF.md`. The selected frontier, frozen inputs and `upstream/` are unchanged.

## Task and overlap

OS seed **28**, complex-supplier track; exact base `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`. `CLAIM.md` records the three candidates and bounded investigation; `SOURCES.json` pins predecessor heads and source hashes.

This addresses a restricted part of the masked-identity opening explicitly left by #968 and #1077. Concurrent #1180 instead extends the **all-pairs cost floor** with both factors root-linear and explicitly excludes masked identities. Its proof/README were inspected at the recorded head; its new theorem is not imported or certified here. The similar cancellation fixture is credited as a shared scope control. Final metadata inspection covered 798 open PRs and current discussion claims.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-masked-rigidity-seed28/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_ONE_SIDED_MASK_RIGIDITY_S28 sets=1373 local_spans=143584 controls=7`.

Passed on macOS arm64 / CPython 3.14.7, also under `-O`:

- 7744 exact covariance entries and a 12544-entry nine-term positive example with a non-root-linear opposite factor.
- Independently implemented enumeration and exact minors covering all **143584** local spans across **1373** domains; 122 reused minors, nonzero integer determinants certified modulo 3.
- Seven main semantic controls, three oracle controls, and rejection of a corrupted saved witness. Separate AI review cross-checked every minor using integer Bareiss elimination and all coverage assignments.
- All five selected-record integrity tests and `git diff --check`.

One local replay took 0.43 seconds. No full selected-supplier cold replay, native admission, hosted Linux CI or formal multiplication theorem is claimed. `VALIDATION.md` records the boundary.

Prepared for Philipp / @mightyOil with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate AI implementation and review; no independent human review claimed. Apache-2.0.
